Usage: suitecloud account:manageauth [options]

Manages authentication IDs for all your projects. An authentication ID is a
custom alias you give to a specific account-role combination.

Options:
  --info <argument>      Prints the following information for the specified
                         authentication ID: account ID, role ID, and url.
                         Usage: account:manageauth --info [myAuthId].
  -i, --interactive      Runs the account:manageauth command in interactive
                         mode.
  --list                 Prints a list of all the configured authentication
                         IDs. Usage: account:manageauth --list.
  --remove <argument>    Removes an authentication ID. The tokens are not
                         revoked in the account. Usage: account:manageauth
                         --remove [myAuthId].
  --rename <argument>    Renames an authentication ID. You must specify it
                         together with the renameto option. Usage:
                         account:manageauth --rename [myAuthId] --renameto
                         [newAuthId].
  --renameto <argument>  Specifies the new ID for an authentication ID. You
                         must specify it together with the rename option.
                         Usage: account:manageauth --rename [myAuthId]
                         --renameto [newAuthId].
  -h, --help             Displays help for the command.
